subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp timestamp correlation introduce a bounded additional wait for matching inbound messages, and if so should that behavior be opt-in or the default for configured WhatsApp debounce?
rationale: Source evidence establishes the missing behavior, but source code cannot choose the acceptable reply-latency budget, collision policy for second-resolution timestamps, or whether a new public setting is warranted.

options.title: Approve opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-local bounded timestamp-coalescing mode with documented sender/chat eligibility, a hard maximum hold, and regression coverage while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Keep receive-time debounce only
options.body: Decline timestamp correlation and direct users to the existing debounce duration because predictable response latency takes priority over delayed-event grouping.

options.title: Design broader batching separately
options.body: Treat this as input to a channel-agnostic batching design instead of adding WhatsApp-specific timestamp policy now.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-local bounded timestamp-coalescing mode with documented sender/chat eligibility, a hard maximum hold, and regression coverage while preserving current defaults.
